# public-comments

The public-review record: one public-comment/1.0.0 file per comment (comments/PC-0042.json), one changeset/1.0.0 file per change-set (changesets/CS-012.json), one manifest per intake batch (batches/), and config.json naming the editors and review committee. A public comment is a todo kind, so anything that reads todos reads these. Moved only by folio-assistant-core/scripts/public-comment.ts. The original spreadsheets hold reviewers' emails and are NOT kept here.

Part of [Reference Architecture and Guidance for Digital Public Infrastructure for the Health Sector](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `public-comments`, holding `todo-items`, `public-comments`.

| file | what it is | used by |
